seoTitle: Cancel & Delete Google Workspace Without Losing Data
metaDescription: Ending your Google Workspace trial or subscription? Learn how to turn off auto-renewal, cancel correctly, and preserve your emails and data first.
intro: Canceling a Google Workspace subscription without accidentally getting charged again or losing important data takes a bit of care, especially around auto-renewal and data retention settings. This guide covers turning off auto-renewal, canceling from the Admin Console, and safely handling your existing data before shutting things down.

steps.heading: Turn off auto-renewal
steps.body: Log in to your Google Workspace Admin Console and disable auto-renewal first, so you don't get billed again after canceling.

steps.heading: Cancel your active subscription
steps.body: From the Admin Console, cancel the subscription following Google's official cancellation flow rather than simply letting it lapse.

steps.heading: Download important emails and files
steps.body: Before finalizing cancellation, download or export any emails, documents, or files you need to keep, since access will be lost once the account closes.

steps.heading: Manage user data retention
steps.body: Review Google Workspace's data retention options to control how long user data remains accessible after cancellation.

steps.heading: Confirm the account is fully closed
steps.body: Verify through the Admin Console that the subscription is fully canceled and no further charges are scheduled.

faq.question: Will I be charged again if I don't turn off auto-renewal?
faq.answer: Yes, if auto-renewal is still active when your subscription period ends, you can be charged again, so it needs to be turned off manually.

faq.question: Can I get my emails back after canceling Google Workspace?
faq.answer: Generally no, which is why downloading or exporting emails and files before finalizing cancellation is an important step.

faq.question: Does canceling during a free trial still require these steps?
faq.answer: Yes, ending a trial correctly still involves canceling through the Admin Console to make sure billing doesn't start automatically.

faq.question: How do I avoid losing important business data?
faq.answer: Exporting your data ahead of time and understanding the data retention settings are the main ways to prevent losing anything important.
